newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel rejected DASA, open to GEC JV.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel rejected DASA, open to GEC JV.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom and Dassault Industries said on Tuesday they had rejected an offer from Germany's Daimler Benz Aerospace (DASA) for an alliance similar to one DASA has concluded with Lagardere's Matra.
The companies told a joint news conference they would start talks with DASA if their offer to buy the French government's 58 percent stake in Thomson-CSF were approved.

They said they had agreed to start talks with Britain's GEC with a view to creating a European joint venture integrating part of the companies' defence electronics activities if the joint Alcatel/Dassault offer for Thomson were accepted.

Alcatel chairman Serge Tchuruk told a joint news conference that the Alcatel/Dassault offer was a better guarantee for France's national defence interests than the rival bid from Lagardere, which also involves DASA and British Aerospace.
